introduction: Every table and view in the `steam_pipeline` database, by layer: raw landing, normalized tables, analytics marts, views, operations, and legacy. All timestamps are UTC. Structure is read from `information_schema`; descriptions live in `docs/data_dictionary.json`. Sources and their caveats are in [`sources.md`](sources.md), how marts are built in [`marts.md`](marts.md), which tables feed which mart in [`lineage.md`](lineage.md), and the data-quality checks in [`observability.md`](observability.md).

layers.title: Raw landing layer
layers.description: Every API response, stored before parsing so any run can be reprocessed.

raw_api_responses.description: One row per API request any job made, including failed ones. Bodies are zlib-compressed; a body identical to the previous one for the same request is stored once, and later rows point to it. Bodies older than `RAW_RETENTION_DAYS` are removed; metadata is kept.

columns.run_id: The job run that made the request.
columns.request_params_hash: SHA-256 of endpoint plus canonical parameters; identifies the same request across runs.
columns.http_status: HTTP status; NULL when the request failed before a response (see error_message).
columns.fetched_at: When the response was received (collection time, not source time).
columns.payload: zlib-compressed response body; NULL for duplicates, failures and purged bodies.
columns.payload_sha256: SHA-256 of the uncompressed body; kept after purging.
columns.is_duplicate_of: The earlier row holding an identical body for the same request.
columns.error_message: Connection error text for requests without a response.

layers.title: Catalog and dimensions
layers.description: Loaded by `catalog_daily` from the SteamSpy catalog page and the Steam Store.

games.description: One row per game in the catalog: the SteamSpy page (frozen, see sources.md), tracked apps, and games seen in Valve's top-100 or most-played charts (ADR 5). The name is the Store's once Store details arrive.

columns.developer: Raw SteamSpy developer string; normalized links are in game_developers (from the Store once its details are known).
columns.publisher: Raw SteamSpy publisher string; normalized links are in game_publishers.
columns.languages: Raw SteamSpy languages; empty for catalog-page games (use game_languages).
columns.genre: Raw SteamSpy genre; empty for catalog-page games (use game_genres).
columns.first_seen_at: Load time of the first catalog run that included the game.
columns.last_seen_at: When the game was last seen: on the SteamSpy page, or in Valve's charts for games added from them.
columns.catalog_source: How the game entered the catalog: `steamspy` (the SteamSpy page or a tracked-app backfill), `valve_chart` (Valve's top-100 or most-played charts) or `tracked` (STEAM_TRACKED_APPIDS).
columns.name_source: Where `name` comes from: `store` (Store details, preferred), `steamspy`, or `placeholder` ("App <appid>" until the Store details arrive).

game_metric_snapshots.description: SteamSpy values per game per catalog run, append-only. SteamSpy gives no source time and can stay unchanged for long periods; use for broad comparison, not as a time series.

columns.snapshot_time: Collection time of the catalog run (not when SteamSpy measured the values).
columns.owners: SteamSpy owner range as text, e.g. `10,000,000 .. 20,000,000`.
columns.ccu: SteamSpy's concurrent-user figure; not a reliable current-player count.

companies.description: Each developer or publisher name once (case- and accent-insensitive), split from SteamSpy strings.

columns.position: Order in the SteamSpy string, starting at 1.
Order in the SteamSpy string, starting at 1.

game_details.description: Steam Store details per game, refreshed by refresh_hourly in hourly slices so every game is refreshed every `DETAILS_REFRESH_DAYS` (games without details first; ADR 6). NULL means the Store did not return the value.

columns.store_available: FALSE when the Store returned no data (delisted or region-locked); other columns then keep their last known values.
columns.release_date: Parsed release date; NULL when the Store text is not a complete date.
columns.release_date_text: The Store's release date text as returned (English).
columns.details_fetched_at: Load time of the run that last refreshed the Store details.
columns.tags_fetched_at: Load time of the run that last refreshed the SteamSpy tags.
columns.companies_from_store: TRUE once the developer and publisher links come from the Store details; SteamSpy strings then no longer replace them.
columns.run_id: The catalog run that last refreshed the details.

genres.description: Steam Store genres, keyed by the Store's own genre ID.

categories.description: Steam Store categories (e.g. Multi-player), keyed by the Store's own ID.

languages.description: Supported languages named by the Store, each once.

game_languages.description: Links games to their supported languages.

columns.full_audio: The Store marks the language as having full audio.

game_tags.description: Links games to SteamSpy user tags.

columns.votes: Number of users who applied the tag (SteamSpy).

game_price_history.description: Type 2 price history per game and Store country: a new version opens when the daily price check sees a change; unchanged prices write nothing.

columns.price_state: `priced`, `no_price` (sold without a price, e.g. free to play) or `unavailable` (Store returned no data).
columns.currency: ISO currency of the amounts; amounts are never compared across currencies.
columns.initial_price: Price before discount, in minor units (cents).
columns.valid_from: Load time of the check that first saw this price.
columns.valid_to: Load time of the check that saw it change; NULL while current.
columns.is_current: TRUE for the open version; at most one per game and country.
columns.current_key: Generated: makes the open version unique per game and country.

player_observations.description: One row per game per hourly players run (top-100 chart or direct lookup). Rows older than `PLAYER_HOURLY_RETENTION_DAYS` are deleted; player_daily keeps their rollups.

columns.collected_at: Load time of the run (collection time).
columns.source_measured_at: Valve's measurement time from the top-100 chart; NULL for direct lookups.
columns.player_rank: Rank in Valve's top-100 concurrent-player chart; NULL for direct lookups.

player_daily.description: Daily rollup of player_observations per game and UTC day, recomputed for the days each players run touches. Kept forever.

columns.observation_date: UTC date of the measurement time (source time when known, otherwise collection time).
columns.best_rank: Best top-100 rank that day; NULL when only direct lookups.
columns.updated_at: Load time of the run that last recomputed the row.

most_played_daily.description: Valve's daily-peak leaderboard (top 100 by peak players). Not limited to catalog games, so appid has no foreign key.

columns.rollup_date: The UTC day the peaks refer to (the previous complete day at fetch time).
columns.last_week_rank: Rank a week earlier; NULL when Valve reports the game was not ranked (-1).
columns.run_id: The players run that last wrote the row.

review_observations.description: Steam review summary per game per run (all languages and purchase types): the tracked games daily from reviews_daily, every other catalog game every `REVIEWS_REFRESH_DAYS` from refresh_hourly (a daily series by default; ADR 6).

columns.collected_at: Load time of the run (the summary has no source time).

review_rollups.description: Up and down review counts per period from Steam's review histogram, with the source's own dates: monthly for each game's life, daily for the last 30 days.

columns.rollup_type: `month` or `day` (the histogram returned no weekly buckets).
columns.period_start: First day of the period (UTC), as given by the source.
columns.is_partial: The period contains the fetch date and was still filling.
columns.fetched_at: Load time of the newest fetch; an older fetch never overwrites it.

review_reconciliation.description: Per reviews run and game: the histogram's monthly totals compared with the review summary. Counts are recorded; only the positive share is held to a tolerance.

columns.share_difference_points: Absolute difference of the positive shares, in percentage points.

game_events.description: Steam news and update posts per game, one row per news gid; article text is not stored.

columns.feed_type: 1 = the developer's Steam announcements, 0 = external press.
columns.first_seen_at: Load time of the run that first stored the item.

layers.title: Analytics marts
layers.description: Rebuilt after every job by `db/transforms/` (see marts.md and lineage.md).

mart_player_trends.description: Per game and UTC day: peak and average players, 7-day rolling average, day- and week-over-week peak change, rank and its change, top-100 membership, entries and exits, 7-day volatility.

columns.rank_change_dod: Yesterday's best rank minus today's; positive means the game moved up.
columns.volatility_7d_pct: Coefficient of variation of the daily average over 7 days, in percent.

mart_player_peak_hours.description: Per game: the most frequent hour (Prague time) of the daily player peak, over days with at least 12 hourly observations.

mart_review_trends.description: Per tracked game and UTC day: total and new reviews, lifetime and 30-day positive share, and sentiment drift.

columns.new_reviews: Change in total reviews since the previous observation; can be negative.

mart_price_status.description: Per game and Store country: current price, discount, on-sale flag, lowest recorded price, distance from it, discount events and days since the last discount.

columns.above_lowest_pct: How far the current price is above the lowest recorded price in the same currency.

mart_genre_summary.description: Per Store genre: games, average Steam review score (latest summary per game) and Metacritic, top-100 presence, release-year groups, platform and free/paid counts.

mart_tag_summary.description: Per SteamSpy tag: games, total votes, average Steam review score (latest summary per game), top-100 presence, release-year groups and platform counts.

mart_release_year_summary.description: Per Store release year: games, free and paid counts, average SteamSpy review score and Metacritic.

mart_engagement.description: Per game: latest daily peak against SteamSpy's owner estimate and playtime skew. Rough by design (estimates, latest snapshot only).

columns.rough_peak_to_owners_pct: Latest daily peak as a share of estimated owners.

mart_event_impact.description: Per developer patch-notes post: average daily players in the 7 days before and after the event day. A correlation, not proof of cause.

latest_successful_run.description: The latest successful catalog run that loaded SteamSpy snapshots (`catalog_daily`, or `daily_legacy` before the job split). Since ADR 5 the SteamSpy page is fetched every `STEAMSPY_PAGE_INTERVAL_DAYS`.

current_game_metrics.description: games joined with their SteamSpy snapshot from the latest catalog run that loaded one. SteamSpy is frozen; games added from Valve's charts have no snapshot.

top_games_by_owners.description: current_game_metrics with owner estimates, for ranking by estimated owners.

top_games_by_review_score.description: current_game_metrics for games with at least 10,000 SteamSpy reviews, for ranking by positive share.

most_active_games_by_ccu.description: Legacy: SteamSpy ccu from the latest snapshot. SteamSpy ccu is not a reliable player count; use player_observations.

free_vs_paid_summary.description: Free versus paid games in the latest snapshot by SteamSpy price (0 = free), with average owners, review score and ccu.

publisher_summary.description: Per raw SteamSpy publisher string in the latest snapshot: game count and owner estimates.

game_metric_trends.description: SteamSpy snapshots of successful catalog runs with game attributes, for audit.

game_metric_changes.description: Snapshot-to-snapshot changes of SteamSpy values per game (window functions), for audit.

game_price_summary.description: Per game and Store country: the current price version with lowest price, discount events and days since the last discount derived from game_price_history.

daily_pipeline_summary.description: Successful runs per UTC day and job, with rows and observations loaded.

layers.title: Operations
layers.description: Run audit, data quality and schema history.

pipeline_runs.description: One row per job run, with status, counters and messages.

columns.job_name: `catalog_daily`, `players_hourly`, `reviews_daily`, `backfill`, or `daily_legacy` for runs before the job split.
columns.rows_extracted: Rows received from the job's main source.
columns.rows_loaded: Rows loaded (games, observations or rollups, depending on the job).
columns.rows_rejected: SteamSpy rows rejected by row-level validation (catalog runs).
columns.warning_message: Degraded input and failed checks of a successful run, one per line.

data_quality_results.description: Every data-quality check and mart test result, stored after the runs of the job that owns each check (freshness after every run; see observability.md).

columns.target: The source, table or table.column checked.
columns.status: `pass`, `warn` or `fail`; a fail adds a warning to the owning job's run and never deletes data.

run_steps.description: How long each step of a pipeline run took, for finding slow or redundant work (see observability.md). Written at the end of every run, for a failed run up to the failing step; reprocessing writes none.

columns.position: Order in which the step started within the run.
columns.step: Step name: a run phase (`setup`, `job`, `finish`, `marts`, `checks`), a step of the job such as `fetch_catalog`, a mart file or a check group.
columns.parent_step: The step this one ran inside; NULL for the run's phases.
columns.status: `ok`, or `failed` for the steps the run's error passed through.
columns.duration_ms: Wall time of the step, from a monotonic clock.
columns.wait_ms: Part of `duration_ms` spent in deliberate pauses between API requests (rate limits, see request_budget.md).
columns.requests: API responses recorded in raw_api_responses during the step.
columns.rows_affected: Rows the step wrote, where the step reports it.

steam_game_measurements.description: Combined player and review measurements of the single daily run used before the job split. Copied into player_observations and review_observations; no longer written.
